definitions.explanation: A book issued by a bank to record deposits, withdrawals, and account balance.

examples.japanese: {通帳|つうちょう}を{記帳|きちょう}する。
{通帳|つうちょう}と{印鑑|いんかん}をお{持|も}ちください。
examples.english: Please bring your passbook and seal.

examples.japanese: {通帳|つうちょう}の{残高|ざんだか}を{確認|かくにん}したら、{思|おも}ったより{少|すく}なかった。
examples.english: When I checked the passbook balance, it was less than I expected.

notes:
A common banking term. While online banking has become prevalent, physical passbooks remain widely used in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {通帳|つうちょう}を{記帳|きちょう}する (to update a passbook)
- {通帳|つうちょう}を{作|つく}る (to open an account/get a passbook)
- {通帳|つうちょう}を{紛失|ふんしつ}する (to lose a passbook)
- {普通|ふつう}{預金|よきん}{通帳|つうちょう} (savings account passbook)

RELATED TERMS:
- {預金|よきん}: deposit
- {残高|ざんだか}: balance
- {記帳|きちょう}: updating/recording in passbook
- キャッシュカード: cash card, ATM card
